method: weighted-Chebyshev spectral collocation for the nonlocal traction eigenproblem lambda f = -int_0^1 S(Z,Xi) f'''(Xi) dXi, f''' expanded in (Z(1-Z))^{-1/2} T_k(2Z-1) (Cauchy part analytic, regular kernel part by paneled Gauss quadrature), f_k = triple integral of f'''_k with f(0)=f'(1)=f''(1)=0, collocation at interior Chebyshev points
